description: Street lighting conduits is a dataset listed in City of Vancouver Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Vancouver. The street light conduits (ducts) dataset represents part of the City's Street Lighting network, which also includes: street lighting poles (nodes) abandoned conduits junction boxes service panels Data currency This data is updated frequently in the normal course of business, however priorities and resources determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the ... Coverage: Vancouver. The portal files it under Streets and transportation. Its keywords are street lighting. The portal shows 65,458 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Vancouver (https://opendata.vancouver.ca/pages/licence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-vancouver-ca-portal.
